title: Rainspell Dial: Three-Field Sound Garden
summary: A palm-size, hand-powered desktop sound toy whose broad wheel carries one captive gravity plectrum across 46 visible printed ribs arranged as rain, frog-song, and cricket fields. Six dry-assembled rigid-filament parts provide a continuous reset, guarded contact path, three separately ported chamber geometries, and tool-free cap-controlled service.

interaction.primary_control: Turn the broad outer wheel clockwise by hand.
interaction.reset: The 360-degree path is continuous; each field is separated by a 7-degree rib-free lane.
interaction.reverse_use: Reverse rotation is reserved as a geometric clearing direction and has not been physically tested.

printed_parts.name: Broad hand wheel with guarded follower carriage

material_and_print.material: ordinary rigid FDM filament such as PLA or PETG
material_and_print.assembly_policy: dry assembly; no glue, beads, batteries, magnets, string, metal, purchased reeds, or flexible material

make_refinement: The exact Ø14.5 wheel bore and full z=21–25 lower journal land are retained. Above z=25 the wheel uses one rounded 210-degree C-profile, replacing the Invent sketch's sub-nozzle 0.15 mm radial relief and opening the deliberate keeper service route after cap removal.
make_retry_repair: The combined assembly retains native part labels but omits optional per-component STEP presentation colors, removing process-dependent style-record ordering without changing topology, geometry, or bounds. The six generated thickness reports use the host-equivalent relative `project` path. After a third host rejection proved that those 21 files were still not the complete mutable set, the active CAD handoff was rematerialized without run-specific `__cadgen__` caches, and the time-bearing PASS pipeline record was preserved at the product root outside the verifier-mutated project.
limitations: No exact physical print, slicing study, clearance coupon, or assembly trial has been performed.
No microphone, loudness, pitch, hearing-safety, or human listening measurement establishes sound character, recognition, pleasantness, or relative voice strength.
No gravity free-fall, inversion, shake, walking, tipping, retention, bearing-noise, or repeated-cycle wear test has been performed.
The dry chamber labyrinths are serviceable seams and are not claimed airtight or tuned Helmholtz resonators.
Digital print-ready status means the declared CAD, fit, motion, mesh, and 0.8 mm wall gates passed; it is not a claim of successful manufacture.
